traderVoices.line: You again? Buy some food before I lose my fucking appetite looking at you.
You smell worse than the spoiled stock.
Buy something before you ruin my appetite.
Keep your filthy hands off the produce.
Well, the shit magnet found my counter.
Got money, or just another stupid story?
Don't drool on anything you're not buying.
You look hungry. Unfortunately, you also look broke.
Wipe your boots. I sell food here, asshole.
That face could sour a whole barrel.
Come in. The flies already know you.
If you're begging, try the dead outside.
Tell me what you want. Use actual words.
You planning to eat, or just stink?
Fine. You're here. Let's get this over with.
Still alive? Must've finally bought decent food.
Back already? That ration didn't eat itself.
I recognize that ugly mug. Unfortunately.
Didn't I feed you enough last time?
You again. At least bring a bigger wallet.
Look who survived my terrible fucking hospitality.
Another visit. My luck keeps getting worse.
If you're returning an empty can, fuck off.
All right, regular. What are you short on?
You ate everything already? Greedy little shit.
Look with your eyes, not your grubby fingers.
Those prices aren't going to blink first.
You done inspecting every fucking potato?
Smell the food again and you're buying it.
I didn't lay this out for decoration.
Pick a ration. They all beat starvation.
Keep staring. Maybe your wallet will grow.
No sampling. I know your kind of sample.
There's your food. Try chewing, dumbass.
Paid and fed. You're almost tolerable now.
Take the bag. Quit breathing on me.
Good. One less hungry asshole hanging around.
That's yours. Don't complain through a mouthful.
Look at that. You actually brought money.
Enjoy it somewhere I can't hear you eat.
You bought supplies. A rare sensible decision.
I'll buy it. Don't act like it's treasure.
Here's the money. Wash your hands afterward.
That'll move. Unlike you, apparently.
Sold. Now get your junk off my counter.
Fine, I'll take it. Spare me its history.
You've got your dukes. Stop pawing the scale.
Useful stock for once. Who'd you rob?
I paid fair. Don't start that haggling shit.
Got a job for you. Pays better than standing here making the place smell like shit.
There's work. Unless you're allergic to effort.
Earn your groceries instead of whining about prices.
I've got something harder than opening a can.
Read the job. Don't make me sound it out.
Want supper money? Do something fucking useful.
This needs handling. Your excuses don't interest me.
Here's a task your empty pockets should like.
You look bored. I've got a cure.
Quit leaning on my counter. Look at this.
Good. Now move your ass.
Bring back results, not a sob story.
Finish it before you start spending the reward.
I hired a worker, not a fucking spectator.
Don't get killed owing me an answer.
You took it. Remember that when it gets ugly.
Go earn something I might call respect.
Scared of work? Explains that empty wallet.
Fine. Starve on your own time.
That was your chance, shit-for-brains.
Keep refusing. I'll keep charging for food.
You haven't finished. Neither have I with you.
Coming back hungry doesn't make the job done.
No results, no pay. Try remembering that.
Did you stop halfway for a fucking picnic?
Finish what you agreed to, then bother me.
Well, shit. You actually got it done. Here's your pay. Don't make me compliment you twice.
You earned this. Don't let it swell your head.
Pay's here. Maybe buy a meal with it.
Not bad, asshole. I was expecting worse.
You finished. That's more than most manage.
Good work. There, that's your whole fucking compliment.
Take the reward. You've kept me waiting enough.
I checked it. You actually did it right.
Well, I'll be damned. A useful customer.
You delivered. I pay. Nobody needs a speech.
That's settled. Don't blow the money on stupidity.
All right, you've earned your place at the counter.
You did good. Tell anyone I said that and we're done.
Eat something before you do another stupid thing.
Shut the door. You're letting your smell linger.
Try leaving with the same number of limbs.
Off you go. My lunch might taste better now.
Come back with money, not an empty stomach.
Take your bag and your bullshit with you.
Keep breathing. Dead customers are lousy business.
Watch yourself, asshole. I'm not replacing you cheaply.
Last chance for groceries. I'm closing soon.
Buy it or leave it. The door's shutting shortly.
Shop's closed. Get the fuck outside.
Food can wait until I open again. Out.
Get in here. You can't fight a damn thing on an empty stomach. What do you need?
Get fed before you pick your next fight.
Stand up straight. What supplies are you missing?
Empty stomachs make weak decisions. Step up.
Come on, survivor. Fuel that sorry-looking operation.
You're running on fumes. Let's fix that.
A fighter who forgets food becomes somebody's lunch.
Quit hovering at the doorway. Approach the counter.
Count your rations, then tell me what's lacking.
You look spent. Hunger's no badge of honor.
Ready for trouble? Your pack says otherwise.
Let's get you stocked and moving again.
What's the mission today, besides staying upright?
You've got guts. Now get something into them.
Another survivor who thinks bravado replaces breakfast.
Back for more fuel? That's sensible.
You kept moving. Good. Replenish those rations.
Still standing. Let's keep the supply line working.
How'd the provisions hold up out there?
You made another run. What got used?
Returning empty-handed? Better count what you need.
There's my regular. Ready to load up?
Hungry again? Good. Means you're still fighting.
You're learning to resupply before collapse. About time.
All right. Report your shortages.
Choose food you can carry through the whole run.
Think ahead. One meal isn't a supply plan.
Quit admiring cans. Figure out your requirements.
You want variety or something that'll keep you moving?
Pick supplies for the work, not the pretty wrapper.
Don't buy like the world ends this afternoon.
Take inventory before you make that decision.
A stocked pack beats a heroic fucking hunger pang.
Good choice. Now put that fuel to use.
Rations secured. One less weakness to worry about.
You're provisioned. Don't waste it loafing around.
Take the supplies. Finish strong out there.
That'll help keep you upright. Eat before trouble.
Paid up. Pack it where you can reach it.
There. Preparation beats complaining every time.
Get moving while you've still got daylight and energy.
Useful supplies. I'll take them off your hands.
That's stock I can work with. Here's your pay.
You brought something worthwhile. Good initiative.
Deal's done. Turn those dukes into readiness.
That's settled. Keep the gear you actually need.
I'll buy it. You know your own loadout.
Fair exchange. No hesitation required.
Good haul. Try putting the proceeds to work.
You want to earn your next meal? Read this. Then show me you can finish what you start.
I've got work that takes more than an appetite.
Want rations? Earn them with some backbone.
Read this task. Decide whether you're ready.
There's pay available for somebody who follows through.
You want a challenge? I've got one waiting.
Provision yourself first. This job isn't a stroll.
Take a look. The reward could restock your pack.
Enough standing around. There's work outside.
You can talk tough after you bring results.
Good. Eat, prepare, and execute.
Commit to it. Don't wander off halfway.
Watch your supplies. Finish the task.
You've accepted. Now show me some follow-through.
Get it handled before hunger slows you down.
That's the spirit. Bring your ass back standing.
No wasted motion. You've got work to do.
Your choice. Don't confuse hesitation with strategy.
Then come back when you've got some resolve.
Not ready? Better admit it than die proving otherwise.
Fine. I'll find somebody who wants the pay.
Still unfinished. You know what comes next.
Don't report a victory you haven't earned.
Regroup if you must. Then finish it.
The job's waiting, and I'm still expecting results.
You're resupplied? Good. Get back to the task.
You finished it and came back standing. Good. There's your pay. That's how you earn respect.
Solid work. Your effort earned that reward.
You delivered. Now restore what the job consumed.
That's how you prove you can be relied on.
Task complete. Collect your pay and recover.
Good follow-through. I like a survivor with discipline.
Here's the reward. Go get a proper meal.
You held up your end. I hold up mine.
Well handled. Keep that standard on the next one.
No excuses, just results. That's worth paying for.
You've earned a rest. Don't mistake it for retirement.
That's a job finished properly. Take the money.
You came back capable. Keep yourself that way.
Stay fed. Stay sharp. Keep moving.
Don't go into trouble running on an empty stomach.
Pack your food before you chase a fight.
Take care of the body doing the work.
See you after the next successful run.
Out you go. Make the supplies count.
Watch your back, and ration your strength.
Come back standing. That's an order worth following.
Closing soon. Secure your rations now.
Last supply check. I'm locking up shortly.
Trading's finished. Clear the shop.
We're closed. Return when the doors open.
There you are, hon. Have you eaten? Come look at what I've got.
Come in. You look like you've missed breakfast.
Something warm would do you good today.
Hey, hungry traveler. What can I get you?
You're welcome here. Let's find you something filling.
Have you been eating properly out there?
That stomach sounds louder than the customers.
Oh, look at you. Come get some provisions.
I'm glad you found your way to my counter.
Don't be shy. Everybody needs to eat.
Rough morning? We can start with a meal.
Tell me what you like. I'll help you choose.
You look tired, hon. Hungry too?
Come closer. You don't have to shout for supper.
Let's make your next meal an actual meal.
There you are. Did you like what you bought?
It's good to see a familiar hungry face.
Back for provisions? I hoped you would be.
You made it home last time. That matters.
How's that appetite treating you today?
I was wondering when you'd need another bag.
Oh, you're back. Found anything good on the road?
Please tell me you've eaten since our last visit.
Another trip survived. Let's celebrate with something decent.
Always room for you at this counter.
Take your time choosing something you'll enjoy.
If you're unsure, tell me what you need.
You can look without pretending you know everything.
Think about tomorrow's meal too, sweetheart.
Some days, familiar food helps more than you'd expect.
Don't worry. Nobody's grading your grocery choices.
Have a good look. Hunger makes everything tempting.
Let's find supplies that suit your trip.
Here you go. I hope it hits the spot.
You've got your food. Look after yourself now.
Lovely. That's one less missed meal to worry about.
Take your bag, hon. Enjoy every bite.
A proper purchase for a proper appetite.
Thank you. I'm glad I could keep you supplied.
There we are. Don't forget to actually eat it.
Enjoy your provisions. You deserve better than scraps.
I can use this. Thank you for bringing it.
Here's your payment. You helped my stock today.
That works for me, sweetheart. All settled.
You found something useful. I'm happy to buy it.
There you go. Your effort shouldn't go unpaid.
Nice little haul. This will find a home.
I've paid you. Keep something back for yourself.
That's a fair trade. I appreciate it.
I could use a hand, hon. Have a look first. I'd like you back for the reward, not carried back.
There's work if you're looking for grocery money.
Would you take a look at this for me?
I need help, but I'd like you properly fed first.
This task might put your next meal within reach.
You've got a steady head. Could you help here?
Read it over, hon. Decide what feels manageable.
I could use somebody who knows when to be careful.
There's a reward waiting if this suits you.
Would a job help you get stocked up?
Thank you. Please eat something before heading out.
I'm counting on you, but I want you safe.
That's a relief. Take care with the task.
Go prepared, hon. The reward can wait for you.
You said yes. Now let's get you back afterward.
Do your best, and don't neglect yourself.
I appreciate the help. Watch that empty stomach.
That's all right. Don't agree just to please me.
Another time, perhaps. Have something to eat anyway.
I understand. You know your limits better than I do.
No hard feelings, hon. I can keep looking.
Still working on it? Make sure you're eating.
You haven't finished yet. Is something giving you trouble?
The reward's still waiting when the work is done.
Take a breath, then see what remains.
Not quite there, sweetheart. Don't lose heart now.
There you are. Job done and back in one piece. Take your pay, hon. Go get yourself a decent meal.
You earned every duke. Let me get your reward.
Wonderful. Now you can afford a decent supper.
I'm pleased you finished, and happier you returned.
Here's the pay. Don't spend it all before eating.
You helped me out. I haven't forgotten that.
Job done, tired traveler. Rest those feet a moment.
You've been reliable. That means a lot here.
Take the reward, hon. You made a difference.
That's good work. Please give yourself some credit.
You came through for me. Thank you, sincerely.
A finished job and a familiar face. Lovely.
You kept your promise. Here's mine in dukes.
Go gently, and don't skip your meals.
I hope your next stop has a friendly table.
Take care, sweetheart. Come back when you're hungry.
Keep a little food for the way home.
Safe travels. I'll be here when you return.
Enjoy what you bought. You earned a quiet meal.
Mind yourself out there. I'd miss our little visits.
Bye for now. Come tell me how you're doing.
I'll be closing soon, hon. Need any last provisions?
We're nearly done for today. Choose what you need.
That's closing time. I'll see you when we reopen.
Time to head out, sweetheart. Trading's finished now.
My friend, you look hungry. Let's put those dukes toward something you'll appreciate.
Welcome. An appetite is an excellent shopping companion.
A sensible survivor keeps their pantry ahead of trouble.
My friend, those provisions won't buy themselves.
You look like somebody who appreciates a full plate.
Come browse. Hunger deserves a better negotiating partner.
There's a customer who understands the value of supper.
Good to see you. Let's invest in tomorrow's breakfast.
An empty pack? What a splendid place to start.
Step up. I've got supplies worth making room for.
A little food money can improve your whole day.
Welcome, valued traveler. What's missing from your meals?
You're just in time to make a useful purchase.
Fine taste starts with having something to eat.
Let's find provisions worthy of your hard-earned dukes.
Returning customers make the best-fed survivors.
Ah, you enjoyed the selection enough to return.
My friend, another grocery run is always welcome.
Back to replenish? Excellent foresight on your part.
You know where a smart appetite goes shopping.
I see those supplies served you well enough.
A familiar customer and fresh business. Delightful.
Welcome back. Shall we improve on last visit's bag?
You made room in the pantry, I take it.
Good to have your custom at my food counter again.
Compare the options. Better provisions deserve some thought.
A modest purchase now beats desperate shopping later.
Look carefully. Your next meal is a serious investment.
You'll find reasons to fill more than one pocket.
Consider a spare ration while you're deciding.
A discerning buyer thinks beyond today's appetite.
No rush, my friend. Let the supplies persuade you.
Price matters. So does having food when you need it.
An excellent investment in continued breathing.
Your provisions, my friend. A satisfying arrangement.
You've made a practical choice with those dukes.
Purchased and packed. May your next meal impress you.
Thank you. Good customers deserve well-stocked bags.
That's yours now. I hope hunger appreciates your taste.
A pleasure doing grocery business with you.
There we are. Preparation has a very reasonable payoff.
This should interest another hungry customer. Sold.
You've supplied my shelves. Here's your consideration.
A useful acquisition for my stock. Thank you.
My friend, that's a transaction we can both enjoy.
I'll find it a buyer. You take the payment.
Fine. Your surplus becomes my next opportunity.
You brought value to the counter today.
The exchange is complete. Your dukes are ready.
My friend, here's a chance to turn a little work into your next purchase. Take a look.
Here's work that could improve your grocery budget.
A capable customer deserves a chance to earn more.
My friend, consider this an investment of effort.
This reward could make your next visit more enjoyable.
Read the task. There's purchasing power at the end.
Why let an opportunity pass while your pantry shrinks?
A little initiative can pay for a great many meals.
I've got work with a reward worth considering.
You might turn today's energy into tomorrow's supplies.
Excellent. May this prove a worthwhile undertaking.
That's initiative. I'll have the reward when you finish.
A promising decision from a sensible customer.
Go prepared. A successful worker makes a happy buyer.
You've accepted the opportunity. Now make it pay.
I look forward to hearing about your success.
Good. The path to a fuller pantry starts there.
A pity. Your grocery budget might have thanked you.
Of course, my friend. Opportunities require willing customers.
Perhaps the prospect will appeal on another visit.
Very well. I'll offer the work elsewhere.
The investment hasn't matured into a reward yet.
Finish the task, and we can settle the commission.
Still underway? I look forward to the completed result.
I'm sure you understand why payment waits.
There's earning potential left outside, my friend.
Excellent work, my friend. Here's your reward. Now, what were you saying about needing supplies?
The effort paid off. Your reward, as promised.
Excellent results. Now your grocery options have expanded.
A reliable customer and worker. What a combination.
You've earned these dukes. Spend them thoughtfully.
My friend, you've turned initiative into purchasing power.
The job is complete, and my obligation follows.
Take your reward. I appreciate dependable business.
Nicely handled. That success deserves a proper supper.
This is why I enjoy working with capable people.
You're paid. The pantry needn't remain an ambition.
A very satisfactory result on both sides.
You've demonstrated value. I'm glad to compensate it.
May your provisions last until our next transaction.
Safe travels, my friend. Eat well along the way.
Come back when your pantry needs professional attention.
Enjoy your purchases. That's the best advertisement.
A pleasure, as always. Keep those shopping habits.
Take care of yourself and your grocery budget.
I trust we'll do profitable food business again.
Go well. A satisfied appetite brings return custom.
Final purchases, my friend. The food counter closes soon.
One last chance to invest in tonight's supper.
Trading has ended. I'll welcome your custom after reopening.
The shop is closed now. Your next purchase must wait.
Howdy, partner. You look hungrier than a hound at supper. Come have a gander.
Howdy. Your stomach get here ahead of you?
Come in, partner. Let's put something in that belly.
You look hungry enough to eat the price tag.
Pull up to the counter. Supper's worth discussing.
Reckon a grocery bag would improve your mood.
Mornin', traveler. Been living on crumbs again?
Well now, somebody's ready for a proper feed.
Don't hover like a crow over a cornfield.
Come have a gander at the provisions.
You've got that last-ration look about you.
A full belly makes the road less miserable.
What's cookin', partner? Hopefully something you can buy.
Step inside. Hunger's a poor reason for shyness.
You made it here. Let's tackle the eating part.
Back before the crumbs settled. That's an appetite.
Howdy again. You wear out that grocery sack?
Reckon you've found my food handy on the road.
There's my regular. Ready to fill the cupboard?
Well, you didn't disappear between meals. Good.
Still got a little spring in your step.
Come on back. I figured those rations wouldn't last.
Another run behind you, another meal ahead.
How'd that last bag treat you, partner?
I know that face. Usually means provisions are low.
Have a gander. No use buying blind.
Think on what'll fit your pack, partner.
A spare meal beats licking the empty tin.
Don't let your eyes shop past your pockets.
Pick something you'll still want after a long walk.
No need to poke every bit of produce.
Have yourself a look while I mind the counter.
Reckon you know your appetite better than I do.
There you are. Enough to quiet that belly.
Bag's yours, partner. Enjoy a proper bite.
That purchase ought to sweeten the road a little.
Good groceries beat an evening of stomach complaints.
You're paid up. Get those provisions tucked away.
Much obliged. You've chosen yourself some useful stock.
Take your food before your stomach files a complaint.
Well now, that's supper sorted out.
I can find a use for that haul.
You've brought stock instead of tall tales. Appreciated.
Here's your pay. Don't lose it in the grocery bag.
That's sold, partner. A fair bit of business.
Reckon that'll leave my shelf soon enough.
You found it; I'll find its next owner.
Money's counted. We can call that settled.
Much obliged for keeping my counter busy.
Got a job over yonder, partner. Bit of hard work ought to put supper back in reach.
Got work that'll put groceries within reach.
A little elbow grease could fill that pack.
Have a look, partner. Might suit your talents.
I've got a task needing more than wishful thinking.
Reckon you'd rather earn supper than dream about it.
Here's something to do while you're full of energy.
Read this before you go promising the moon.
Useful work's waiting, and there's pay behind it.
Could use a hand getting this job squared away.
That's the ticket. Get yourself fed before leaving.
Much obliged, partner. Keep your head on straight.
You took it on. See it through carefully.
Pack provisions. Can't work on a hollow belly.
I'll be waiting for the good news.
Don't run yourself ragged chasing those dukes.
Go on, then. Give it your best honest effort.
Fair enough. Can't drag a mule by wishing.
Reckon that job wasn't your cup of tea.
All right. I'll rustle up another willing hand.
Well, bless your fucking heart. Maybe next time.
Still a few rows left to hoe, partner.
You ain't at the paying end of it yet.
Finish that job before we count the reward.
Something hung you up? Keep after it sensibly.
Don't let the last bit of work whip you.
Well, hot dog. You got it done, partner. Take your pay and put a little supper in that belly.
Hot dog. You've earned yourself a good meal.
That job's wrapped up tighter than a lunch parcel.
Good work, partner. Here's what you're owed.
You carried it through. I appreciate a steady hand.
That ought to put supper money in your pocket.
Well now, you're worth more than your own bragging.
Reward's counted. You've done me a real favor.
Looks like hard work won out today.
Take your pay and give those boots a rest.
You made that job behave. Nicely done.
Much obliged. I reckon you earned the smile.
Finished and home again. Can't ask much better.
Keep a ration where you can find it.
Happy trails, partner. Don't forget to eat.
Come back before your pantry starts echoing.
Take your groceries and mind the rough patches.
Hope the road treats you better after supper.
See you round. Save a bite for tomorrow.
Travel easy, and keep your pack dry.
Don't let stubbornness keep you hungry out there.
Nearly closing, partner. Need one last bag?
Get your groceries picked. I'm winding down shortly.
Counter's shut for today. Time to mosey along.
That's us closed. Come round after opening again.
Still breathing? Good. Let's see if we can get you fed before you ruin that.
You look hungry. Excellent diagnostic skills on my part.
Food's here. Your decision-making can catch up.
Welcome. Try not to negotiate with your stomach.
You've brought an appetite. Hopefully money accompanied it.
Come in before you start eyeing the furniture.
I sell provisions. Life advice costs your patience.
That's an impressively empty-looking pack you've got.
Breakfast would improve this conversation for both of us.
You need food. I enjoy being right.
Let's get you something better than imaginary supper.
Hungry survivors do make wonderfully direct customers.
You look one missed meal from bad ideas.
Counter's open. Your stomach already noticed.
Try shopping before starvation becomes your whole personality.
Back for food. A refreshingly predictable achievement.
You survived the trip and finished the groceries.
Again? Your appetite certainly has job security.
Welcome back. The empty bag explains enough.
You remember the counter. That's progress worth acknowledging.
Another visit. We should stop pretending you're browsing.
Still hungry, still solvent? Lovely combination.
You made it back. I'd hate wasting a regular.
There's that familiar look of ration regret.
Back before you got desperate. Almost impressive.
Pick something edible. I've narrowed it down considerably.
The food won't make the choice for you.
Keep looking. Maybe a can will propose.
Your pack has limits. Your appetite seems unaware.
Buying a spare ration isn't admitting defeat.
Those are provisions, not a personality test.
Decide before your stomach takes over negotiations.
A grocery plan. Radical concept, I know.
Food acquired. Try the eating part next.
That's yours. Please survive long enough to appreciate it.
A useful purchase. You'll recover from the shock.
You paid. Your stomach can stop making speeches.
Supplies secured. Look at you planning ahead.
Take the bag. You've successfully operated a shop.
Good choice. I won't make that embarrassing.
Lunch solved. The rest of your life is yours.
I'll take that. My shelves enjoy contributions.
Sold. You brought something besides an appetite.
Here's your money. Try remembering where you put it.
Useful stock. Clearly an accident worth encouraging.
That'll find a buyer. You can stop presenting it.
Payment settled. We both get to feel productive.
You sell, I stock. Elegant little arrangement.
Done. Even your surplus has better timing today.
Got work. You finish it, you get paid. Try making that the interesting part of your day.
Want groceries? Here's a remarkably concrete earning strategy.
I've got work. Your stomach nominated you.
Take a look before saying something heroic.
This task pays. Standing here mostly doesn't.
Need a reason to leave the counter? Found one.
Read it. Understanding is a promising first step.
You've got energy for complaints. Try using it here.
Earn a meal instead of rehearsing hunger.
A job, a reward, and your involvement. Thoughts?
Good. Make the actual work your next move.
You're committed. I'd enjoy seeing evidence of that.
Pack food. Starving halfway through is poor technique.
Go handle it. I'll handle being impressed afterward.
Accepted. Try finishing with the same enthusiasm.
That's settled. You have somewhere useful to be.
Do the job. Leave the dramatic suffering optional.
All right. Hunger evidently hasn't persuaded you yet.
Suit yourself. I'll ask someone with momentum.
No? Your wallet has a curious strategy.
Declined. Very efficient way to earn nothing.
You're here. Unfortunately, the finished job isn't.
Still incomplete. I do appreciate consistency, within limits.
Reward follows results. An upsettingly firm sequence.
Did you come back to admire the waiting payment?
Finish it. We've already mastered the discussion part.
Job's done. You're alive. I get to stop waiting. That's a good result for both of us. Here's your pay.
Finished. You've justified both the reward and my patience.
Here's your pay. Perhaps buy something chewable.
A completed job. I was hoping you'd try that.
You delivered. My expectations are mildly inconvenienced.
Take the reward. You've made hunger easier to solve.
Good work. Let's enjoy that without a speech.
You earned the dukes. That looks better on you.
Job handled. Your grocery fund can celebrate.
You're useful when you put your mind to it.
Here's the money. Try not to outsmart supper.
Back with results. That's my preferred entrance.
Done properly, too. You're getting difficult to tease.
Eat before you invent another terrible plan.
See you when hunger brings you back to reason.
Keep your food. Lose the unnecessary heroics.
Survive the road. The groceries won't miss you.
Go enjoy lunch. You've earned a simple victory.
Come back before your pack becomes decorative.
Mind yourself. Replacing customers takes effort.
Travel safely enough to do this again.
Closing soon. Last chance to rescue dinner.
Finish choosing. My door has a firmer deadline.
We're closed. Even hunger can learn opening hours.
Trading's over. Your stomach can complain outside now.
What the fuck are you carrying? Get over here before that piece of shit gets you killed.
That weapon's cleaner than your ugly fucking face.
Buy ammunition before you bore me to death.
Keep your finger off the trigger, dipshit.
You bring dukes or just that stupid grin?
Try pointing your muzzle somewhere less fucking personal.
Look who wandered in wearing target practice.
What do you want, besides a longer life?
You couldn't intimidate an empty cartridge box.
Quit rattling around my shop like loose brass.
You look like you reload by apologizing.
Come closer. I need to hear your stupidity clearly.
That loadout's a cry for help, asshole.
Let's see what your wallet can do right.
Leave the bullshit outside with your bad aim.
Back for rounds? Finally hit something, did you?
Same face. Different excuse for being underarmed?
You survived. The gun deserves most of the credit.
Used up your ammunition missing again?
Didn't that gear cure your stupid yet?
Well, the walking misfire returns.
You again. Better not be shopping for blame.
My least graceful regular. What broke?
Still got your fingers? Surprising fucking development.
Back already? Save a round for actual trouble.
Don't fondle the stock like it's going to love you.
Check what fits before buying, dumbass.
You choosing a firearm or waiting for permission?
Those rounds won't become cheaper through whining.
Look downrange in your imagination. Not at me.
